topic: The anime that predicted a major world disaster — aired one month before
hook: This anime predicted a disaster — one month before it happened.
script: This anime predicted a disaster — one month before it happened. Akira, released in 1988, depicted Tokyo being destroyed and rebuilt for the 2020 Olympics. Tokyo hosted the 2020 Olympics — rescheduled to 2021. The film showed empty stadiums. The Olympics were held with zero spectators due to COVID. Even the year on the stadium in the film matches. Follow for anime predictions that are too accurate to be coincidence.
